outcomes.description: Measured from the time of random sequence generation to the time of progression of bladder cancer as documented by histopathology at the time of TURBT (prompted by abnormal cystoscopy). We defined progression as an increase in tumor stage (defined as lamina propria invasion, e.g. increase from Ta to T1, or CIS to T1; development of muscle invasive disease (stage ≥ T2) and development of new lymph node involvement or metastatic disease) or grade (increase in grade from low to high (including CIS) following the definition of the International Bladder Cancer Group)
